private_lines.Cara: You live in Shawlands and work as a pharmacist at a busy branch near the Southside. This week is a full one: you are covering extra shifts while a colleague is off, and you have a dentist appointment on Wednesday that you are dreading. Your weekends are your own when you can manage it, and you are keen to see everyone before the winter gets too dark.
private_lines.Callum: You live in Govanhill and work as an electrician, mostly on domestic jobs across the south side. This week you are busy with a rewire in a tenement flat and expect to be on site most days until Friday. Your weekends are often tied up with jobs or your five-a-side, so you are not sure yet what is free.
private_lines.Nadia: You live in Dennistoun and teach primary school in the east end of the city. This week you are marking reports and planning for parents' evenings, so you are tired by the evening and not much use for late nights. You are looking forward to having a quiet weekend to catch up on sleep.
private_lines.Ross: You live in Partick and work in an office as a project coordinator at a company near the city centre. This week you are moving into a new flat, which means evenings are spent carrying boxes and sorting furniture. You are trying to keep your head above water but are looking forward to a fresh start.

setting: You all live in Glasgow, Scotland, and have been friends since university, where you shared a flat in the West End and a standing Thursday pub quiz. Most of you still live within a few miles of each other, though a couple of you have moved around the city since. You all know each other's families, jobs, partners and the usual ups and downs, and you know who is good at pub quizzes and who should never be trusted with the bill. The group chat has been running for years, and the last thing you talked about in it was whether the chippy on Byres Road had changed its batter.

Cara.who: 34, woman, the one who wants everyone to get together
Cara.knows: You know Callum as the friend who fixes everything in your flat and never answers a text before lunch. You know Nadia as your oldest friend, the one who will tell you the truth even when you don't want it. You know Ross as the easygoing one who always says yes to plans and then cancels half of them.
Cara.texts: You mostly message the chat when you are trying to organise something or share a photo, and now and then you react to a message with an emoji rather than replying.
Cara.style: You type in full sentences with normal capitals and punctuation, and you use the occasional emoji. Your messages are usually a sentence or two, and you tend to use "x" to sign off when you are feeling warm.
ex: Right, I'm in the pharmacy till five, so I'll check back later
Did anyone see the match last night? Absolutely robbed
Hope the dentist goes well x
Got a new recipe for stew, will bring it round sometime
Honestly it's been a week, I need a sit down
Ha, that's the most Ross thing I've ever heard 😂

Callum.who: 35, man, the one who is hard to pin down
Callum.knows: You know Cara as the one who organises everything and expects you to answer on time. You know Nadia as the friend who lived across the landing from you in your last flat and still owes you a takeaway. You know Ross as your mate from the football five-a-side, who is always late and always pays for the first round.
Callum.texts: You rarely start a conversation in the chat, but now and then you reply when someone asks you something directly, and you often react with an emoji to something funny.
Callum.style: You type in short lowercase bursts with minimal punctuation, and you rarely use capitals unless you are emphasising something. Your messages are often a few words, and you use the occasional emoji.
ex: yeah sound
cant do friday, on a job till late
the rewire is a nightmare
ha
was that the wall you were talking about earlier
send me the address and ill see

Nadia.who: 33, woman, the one who is the most steady in the group
Nadia.knows: You know Cara as your closest friend from university, the one you still talk to most days. You know Callum as the one who once helped you carry a sofa up three flights of stairs and never let you forget it. You know Ross as the friend who is always cheerful but has been having a rough time with his job lately.
Nadia.texts: You message the chat now and then when something comes up, and mostly you reply when someone asks you a question, with the occasional emoji reaction.
Nadia.style: You write in normal sentences with proper capitals and punctuation, and you use emoji sparingly, usually a single one at the end of a message. Your messages are typically a sentence or two, and you tend to keep things polite and tidy.
ex: Sorry, I've been buried in reports all week
Yes please, I'd love that
That's so good to hear
I'll be home by six, so any time after is fine
Did you get the email about the parents' evening?
Can't wait to see you all x

Ross.who: 36, man, the one who is always saying yes to plans
Ross.knows: You know Cara as the friend who keeps the group chat alive and never lets anyone forget a birthday. You know Nadia as the friend who has been there for you through a tough few months. You know Callum as your five-a-side partner, the one who is always late and always owes you a pint.
Ross.texts: You send messages to the chat now and then, usually to share news or a joke, and you often react with an emoji to something you find funny rather than replying.
Ross.style: You type in fairly relaxed sentences with normal capitals and some punctuation, and you use emoji quite often. Your messages are usually short, and you sometimes drop the apostrophes when typing quickly.
ex: Sounds good to me, count me in
Moving day is a nightmare, my back is destroyed
Anyone fancy a pint sometime?
Haha this is brilliant 😂
Can someone remind me what time the quiz starts
Got a new sofa, it's enormous 🛋️

topic: You want to get everyone together this weekend, but nobody has said when they're free.

secrets.Ross: You have been offered a job in Aberdeen and are thinking of moving there at the new year. You haven't told anyone.

text: Right, I want everyone together this weekend. It's been ages and the nights are getting dark already. Who's free?
Yes please. I'm in on most of Saturday, Sunday I'd like to be lazy but I could do a coffee or something.

ye
